pr_title: [Feat] Shared expert dp for deepseek and deepseek_mtp
source_quote:
debug_layer_idx should be named as mtp_layer_idx
it may comfused users. when we set enable_shared_expert_dp, it will lead to set sp=1. But these two settings' meanings are different.

rule.description: 变量命名应准确反映其实际用途（如 `mtp_layer_idx` 而非 `debug_layer_idx`）。配置项之间的关联应明确，避免一个配置隐式设置另一个配置导致用户混淆。
checkpoints: 变量名是否准确反映其用途
配置项是否会产生意外的副作用（如设置 A 隐式修改 B）
相关配置项的含义是否有清晰文档说明
